success.description: With no care for your defence, you hurl yourself to the enemy and hit for normal damage.

As above, but after dealing damage, turn one of the inflicted normal wounds faceup. If its severity is greater than X, turn it facedown. If it is less, turn the next normal wound faceup, adding its severity to the first. If the new total is greater than X, turn the additional wound back facedown. If the total is less than X, repeat this process. Pierce +1 damage. Suffer 1 wound.

conservative.requirements: Melee weapon equipped, engaged with target. You must be outnumbered or facing a physically larger opponent. Add as many {Dc} to the dice pool as the effective armour level you are wearing. Special: When you play this action, you may add 2 recharge tokens to any of your Active Defences, either in your hand or currently recharging. X is the total recharge tokens added in this way.
conservative.name: Giant Feller Strike

success.description: With no care for your defence, you hurl yourself to the enemy and hit for normal +X+1 damage.
As above, but deal +X+3 damage instead. HUR damage, +1 critical.

chaosStar.description: You gain the Exposed condition while this action is in effect.

sigmarsComet.description: Reveal X critical wounds from the wound deck; choose one to apply to the target (damage or effect, choice) and discard the rest. Suffer 1 wound & Suffer 1 fatigue.
